## Workshops

**Discrimination and workplace inequality -- November 2026** 

 Hosted at the [**Centre for Research on Social Inequalities (CRIS)**](https://www.sciencespo.fr/cris/en/), co-organized with Mirna Safi.

This workshop brought together researchers studying labour market discrimination through correspondence studies and administrative data. Through empirical presentations and methodological discussions, it explored how linking these sources can provide new insights into hiring discrimination and its heterogeneity across firms, labour markets, and countries.
